assertions.assertion: Uses WebApplicationFactory<Program> with ConfigureTestServices to override IdentityServer registration
assertions.rationale: IdentityServerFactory extends `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` and overrides registration inside `builder.ConfigureTestServices(...)`.

assertions.assertion: Sets options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false to avoid disk writes in CI
Calls AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) for a static test signing key
Registers clients via AddInMemoryClients — no sub-documents needed for this core pattern
assertions.rationale: Registers `.AddInMemoryClients(TestClients)` (and AddInMemoryApiScopes) inline with no sub-documents.
